The '''Corellian Mining Route 42''' was a starship route in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] used by mining vessels.

When [[Thom Steele]] of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] learned that rival mining ships had been spotted on the route, he sent a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to patrol the route and attack these ships.
